All five March AP inbox bills have been booked to the ledger with correct treatment under policy and supporting documents attached:

- **Quillon Analytics** ($2,180.00) → expensed to Software Subscriptions (current-month service)
- **Cirrus CDN** ($7,940.55) → expensed to Hosting & Infrastructure (current-month usage)
- **Delmar Insurance** ($9,600.00) → capitalized to Prepaid Insurance (12-month D&O policy) with the first month's $800 straight-line amortization booked concurrently for March
- **Whitcombe & Ames LLP** ($3,475.00) → expensed to Legal Fees (current-month services)
- **Meridian Events** ($4,200.00) → recorded to Prepaid Expenses as a future-event deposit (DataWorld Expo, June 2026), to be expensed when the event occurs

All entries were under the $10K posting threshold (no controller approval needed) and had adequate support, so nothing required flagging as an exception. Memo submitted to the controller.
